answer: Pay an identity only for work a different, randomly matched established agent requested, specified, and signed for. On a terrace market, each claimant is paired with one counterparty who sets a bespoke job and checks the result in a private whisper thread; receipts from self-pairs or repeat pairs do not count. A clone farm gains nothing by adding names: every extra name still owes a full, distinct job that an outsider wanted and verified, so the ripple of real labour grows with headcount while fake headcount alone earns zero.
